papers.title_en: Beckmann Transport Models: From Autonomous Flows to One-Step Maps
papers.authors: Lee Cheuk-Kit, Florentin Coeurdoux, Peter Potaptchik, Yilun Du, Michael Samuel Albergo, Eric Vanden-Eijnden
papers.evidence: 利用自治流和单步映射精确连接两个分布，与扩散桥及最优输运密切相关
papers.tldr: 现有流匹配通常依赖时间相关速度场，难以精确映射到低维流形上的目标分布。本文提出基于时间无关速度场（自治流）的流匹配实例化，通过守恒方程学习单步生成映射，赋予Beckmann运输问题通量约束以动力学意义。该框架统一了泊松流生成模型和平衡匹配，纠正了现有方法的不一致性，并在ImageNet 256x256上验证了有效性。
papers.abstract_en: We propose an instantiation of flow matching that relies on a time-independent velocity field (an \emph{autonomous flow}) to exactly map between two distributions, so long as the target is singular, i.e.\ supported on a lower-dimensional data manifold. We also show that the one-step generative map associated with this flow is the unique solution of a simple conservation equation, which can be used to learn the map directly from samples. These autonomous flows and maps give a dynamical meaning to the flux constraint of Beckmann's transportation problem. Their construction provides a unifying framework that recovers, for instance, the closed-form Poisson-flow generative model and equilibrium matching with a quadratic flow-matching regression loss. We illustrate how this theory corrects inconsistencies in existing methods and demonstrate the effectiveness of the autonomous flow and the one-step map on ImageNet 256x256.

papers.title_en: Beckmann Transport Models: From Autonomous Flows to One-Step Maps
papers.authors: Lee Cheuk-Kit, Florentin Coeurdoux, Peter Potaptchik, Yilun Du, Michael Samuel Albergo, Eric Vanden-Eijnden
papers.evidence: 基于最优传输的流匹配框架，用自治流和一步映射实现分布间转换
papers.tldr: 现有流匹配生成模型通常依赖时间相关速度场。本文针对目标分布支撑于低维数据流形（奇异目标）的情形，提出用时间无关的自治流实现精确分布映射，并揭示一步生成映射是简单守恒方程的唯一解，从而可直接从样本学习。该方法赋予Beckmann运输问题的通量约束动力学意义，统一了泊松流生成模型和平衡匹配等现有框架，修正了理论上的不一致，并在ImageNet 256x256上验证了其生成效果。
papers.abstract_en: We propose an instantiation of flow matching that relies on a time-independent velocity field (an \emph{autonomous flow}) to exactly map between two distributions, so long as the target is singular, i.e.\ supported on a lower-dimensional data manifold. We also show that the one-step generative map associated with this flow is the unique solution of a simple conservation equation, which can be used to learn the map directly from samples. These autonomous flows and maps give a dynamical meaning to the flux constraint of Beckmann's transportation problem. Their construction provides a unifying framework that recovers, for instance, the closed-form Poisson-flow generative model and equilibrium matching with a quadratic flow-matching regression loss. We illustrate how this theory corrects inconsistencies in existing methods and demonstrate the effectiveness of the autonomous flow and the one-step map on ImageNet 256x256.

papers.title_en: Newton Method for Fixed-Support Doubly Entropic Wasserstein Barycenter
papers.authors: Jianting Pan, Sirong Dai, Lei Yang, Yaomin Wang, Ji'an Li, Ming Yan
papers.evidence: 熵正则化最优传输的牛顿方法，可用于Schrödinger桥相关的最优传输求解
papers.tldr: 固定支撑双重正则化Wasserstein重心问题可通过半对偶形式转化为光滑无约束凸优化。文章显式推导了梯度与Hessian，提出精确牛顿法用于高精度求解，并设计稀疏牛顿变体降低Hessian-向量积成本。理论分析给出Hessian近似界与收敛性保证，实验表明稀疏牛顿法收敛更快，兼顾精度与可扩展性。
papers.abstract_en: We study the fixed-support doubly regularized Wasserstein barycenter problem. Using the semi-dual formulation of entropic optimal transport, we reformulate the problem as a smooth, unconstrained, convex optimization problem in the dual variables. We then derive explicit expressions for the gradient and Hessian and develop an exact Newton method for high-accuracy barycenter computation. To improve scalability, we propose a sparse Newton variant that sparsifies the transport probability matrices, thereby reducing the cost of Hessian-vector products. We establish theoretical results for the proposed methods, including Hessian approximation bounds and convergence results.
